== Reward ==

<ul><li>  {{:Sejah Ghulam Bracer}}
</li></ul>

== Walkthrough ==

'''Indifferent faction is sufficient to receive the reward for this quest. You may use charm, or have an enchanter charm Shazda for you (however, the faction hits will be omitted in that case).''' 
'''An Iksar monk at lvl 40 can do this quest by sneaking behind the quest giver and handing them the heads to get that juicy monk bracer very easily.  The kerrans do not agro if you over level them.'''

''After you complete the [[First Test of Kejaar]], you will then be told to to kill their most hated foe, Sentinel Creot (approx level 30, possibly higher), a roaming guard in Tox Forest.  If you kill him and return his head you will become a full Sejah warrior, and receive the reward of a Sejah Ghulam Bracer.'' 

''Sentinel Creot wanders but can located along the shore of Toxxulia Forest between the Wizard Hut and the Western Dock. He is a level 30 paladin on Erudin's guards faction.''

'''Attack and lay [[Sentinel Creot]] to waste.'''

You have slain Sentinel Creot!

<div class='facblock'>
* Your faction standing with [[Heretics]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[High Council of Erudin]] got worse.
* Your faction standing with [[High Guard of Erudin]] got worse. 
* Your faction standing with [[Merchants of Erudin]] got worse.                                     
* Your faction standing with [[Kerra Isle]] got better. 
</div>

: Sentinel Creot says, 'Prepare to meet the vengeance of Erud!!'

'''Loot Sentinel Creot's Head and swim over to Kerra Isle.'''

'''Shazda Asad is located in Kerra Isle at 396, -255, -2. '''

You say, 'Hail, Shazda Asad.

: Shazda Asad says, 'Rrrr..I am Asad. Shazda of the Kerran [Sejah]. It is my duty to ensure the safety of what lands have not been taken from us by the Erudites. and to train my soldiers in the fighting styles of our heritage.'

You say, 'What sejah?

: Shazda Asad says, 'The soldiers of our sejah are all trained from the time they are weaned from their matriarchs. If you wish to be honored by the sejah, you must prove to use your loyalty and devotion to the defense of our lands. In Toxxulia Forest there are Erudite emissaries who constantly attempt to encroach upon our territory. Bring me the head of one such emissary.'

'''Upon turning in the head from Sentinel Creot'''

: Shazda Asad says, 'You have proven your self yet again! You are now a full member of our sejah because of this brave act! To show your status here is a bracer for you to wear.'

<div class='facblock'>
* Your faction standing with [[Kerra Isle]] got better.
</div>
